mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) over the past 5 months signals expanding economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite GDPC1 being above its 5-month prior value.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in FEDFUNDS above 5.0% signals monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS remaining above 5.0%

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously, indicating dual tightening in monetary and labor markets, this combination predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS increasing and UNRATE decreasing

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.0% signals strengthening labor markets, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite UNRATE falling below 4.0%

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a quarterly GDPC1 value below 12000 signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are positive despite GDPC1 remaining below 12000 or rising above it but returns negative

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO above 110 indicates robust supply growth, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite INDPRO being above 110

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS below 5.0% and UNRATE below 4.5% signals dual tightening, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are positive despite both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE remaining below their thresholds
